query:
-- Molécules sans QID avec données chimiques disponibles
SELECT id, name, cas_number, iupac_name, molecular_formula
FROM molecules 
WHERE (wikidata_qid IS NULL OR wikidata_qid = '')
  AND (cas_number IS NOT NULL AND cas_number != '' OR iupac_name IS NOT NULL AND iupac_name != '')
ORDER BY name
LIMIT 20;
